questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content:
Match the catalysts to the correct processes :

Catalyst Process
(A) TiCl3 (i) Wacker process
(B) PdCl2 (ii) Ziegler - Natta
polymerization
(C) CuCl2 (iii) Contact process
(D) V2O5 (iv) Deacon's process
